entry.title: a short note about thinking on paper
entry.content:
A quick write-up on thinking on paper, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Thinking on paper shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: rethinking thinking on paper
entry.content:
I spent a while getting thinking on paper wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Thinking on paper shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: thinking on paper in practice
entry.content:

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
